_comment: KOMBI SERVICE-RESET write sequence for a BMW R18-class modern cluster,
reconstructed from MotoScan 1.110 bytecode. THIS TRACE CONTAINS WRITES.
The replay engine REFUSES to execute it (status BLOCKED) and no OpenMoto
firmware or CLI can transmit it: service writes (0x2E) are default-denied by
diag_core.h serviceForbidden() and by host policy. This file exists to DOCUMENT
the recovered sequence and to prove, in tests, that the read-only guard blocks it.
REQUEST byte prefixes are confirmed [APK] from sl0.C(dl0,int,Date,Date):
* 2E E1 2C + 4 bytes  (7-byte array)   -> write next service date [APK]
* 2E E1 2D + 2 bytes  (5-byte array)   -> write service distance   [APK]
sl0.C passes a 2000 ms adapter timeout and sleeps 1500 ms between operations
(these are app choices, not verified ECU timing). The PAYLOAD bytes below are
[INFERRED] placeholders (not decoded field encodings) and the EXPECTED
responses are [INFERRED]. The ORDER (clock, then date, then distance) is [APK].
[UNKNOWN]: whether a diagnostic session (10 xx) or security access (27 xx) is
required first, the exact field encodings, valid ranges, persistence, and
read-back. None of this is verified; do not transmit.
name: kombi-service-reset-r18

steps.note: WRITE clock: 2E E1 2B + 7 bytes [APK prefix/length]; payload INFERRED
WRITE next service date: 2E E1 2C + 4 bytes [APK prefix/length]; payload INFERRED
WRITE service distance: 2E E1 2D + 2 bytes [APK prefix/length]; payload INFERRED
